title: Header overflows a 320px screen on every page: «القائمة» is cut off (or the page pans sideways on a phone)
evidence: Measured on the export (survey.mjs, hdr320.mjs): at 320px every page (/, /started, /built, /passed, /shelf) has documentElement.scrollWidth 342 > clientWidth 320; the only offender is button.menuButton at left -22 to right 89. The bar packs brand (191px: Mark 36 + «أنس» 48 + «anas.studio» 83 + two 12px gaps) + 20px gap + button 111px into 280px; with negative free space justify-content:space-between packs from the start, so the button starts 22px past the left edge. Desktop 320 (= 1280px at 400% zoom): «القائمة» renders as «القائم», its last letter clipped (shots/hdr-320-d.png). Mobile emulation (isMobile): innerWidth widens to 342, scrollX -22, the layout pans sideways and the brand Mark is cut at the right edge (shots/hdr-320-m.png). Fits from 342px (hdr320.mjs: 330 → -12, 340 → -2, 344 → +2).
impact: On 320-wide phones (iPhone SE 1st gen, small Androids, foldable cover screens) and for low-vision visitors at 400% zoom, every page scrolls sideways by 22px and the primary mobile navigation control is clipped. PLANS/VERIFICATION.md requires a 320px fallback; WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow (AA) fails. The visual e2e only checks 360 and up, so nothing catches it.
proposed_fix: Drop the decorative domain under 360px: `@media (max-width: 359px) { .brandDomain { display: none; } }` in site.module.css (the brand link keeps its aria-label «أنس، الرئيسية»). Add 320 to the visual overflow test widths.
prior_overlap: Not in AUDIT-1, AUDIT-2 or tasmeem (they rendered 360 and up).

title: Without JavaScript a phone keeps a 200px sticky header on screen: the wrapped room links take 35% of a 568px screen while reading
evidence: `@media (scripting: none)` shows the inline links and lets the bar wrap (lines 99-110), but `.header { position: sticky; inset-block-start: 0 }` (lines 2-6) stays, and the tuck-away is script. Measured with javaScriptEnabled:false on /started (nojs-scroll.mjs): at 320x568 and 360x640, after scrolling to y=2400 the header is still at top 0, bottom 200 (`position: sticky`); shots/nojs-header-320.png (three rows of links), shots/nojs-scrolled-320.png (reading text under a 200px band).
impact: A visitor without JavaScript (blocked scripts, a failed bundle, some reader modes) on a phone reads every room through 65% of the screen; DESIGN.md promises everything is usable without JavaScript. Bounded to no-JS phone visits.
proposed_fix: Inside the existing `@media (scripting: none)` block add `.header { position: static; }` so the wrapped links scroll away with the page (or keep sticky only from 1024px).
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 G5.2 added the scripting:none inline links; this is a side effect of that fix (the e2e JS-off run covers 768 only).

title: بدأتُ من هنا: the seventh family film is drawn bigger than the other six (an orphan tile up to 560px beside 296-370px tiles) at every width from about 600px
evidence: `.films` is a wrapping flex row and `.films > li { flex: 1 1 280px; max-inline-size: 560px }`, so whatever lands alone on the last row grows to 560px. Measured on the export (films.mjs, tile [left, top, width, height]): 1280x800: six tiles 370x208, then the seventh alone at [656, 4225, 560, 315]; 1024x768: six at 296x167, seventh 560x315; 768x1024: six at 339x191, seventh 560x315; 1440x900: four at 307x173 over three at 417x234. Screenshot shots/started-films-1280x800.png: two even rows, then one film half again as large, start-aligned, with an empty aubergine block beside it.
impact: The films band of the first room reads as a broken grid on every tablet and desktop: one child film looks featured over the others for no reason. Cosmetic; no content is lost.
proposed_fix: Make the list a grid of equal tracks instead of growing flex items: `.films { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 280px), 1fr)); }` and drop the `max-inline-size` on `.films > li` (or keep flex with `flex-grow: 0` and `justify-content: center` so the last row keeps the same size).
prior_overlap: Not reported before; AUDIT-2 PUBLIC-style-10 fixed lattice holes, not this flex list.

title: Home «الغرف»: the eight room doors break into uneven rows at 1024, 1536 and 1920px; the last two or three doors grow to 1.5-3 times the width of the others
evidence: `.doors` is a wrapping flex row and `.doorItem { flex: 1 1 300px }`, so the last row grows to fill. Width sweep (rows.mjs) flags the doors list from 900 to 1920px except where 8 divides evenly (4 per row, about 1200-1499px). Element screenshots of #rooms: shots/home-doors-1920x1080.png (six 320px doors, then «المَشاهد» and «تواصل» at 960px each), shots/home-doors-1536x864.png (five 307px doors over three 512px ones), shots/home-doors-1024x768.png (3 + 3 doors of 341px, then two of 512px). The visual e2e and the DESIGN-B evidence use 1440, where the rows happen to be even.
impact: On the most common desktop widths (1920, and 1536 = 1920 at 125% scaling) and on a landscape iPad, the home page main navigation looks broken: «المَشاهد» and «تواصل» become giant banners that outweigh the four rooms the page is about.
proposed_fix: Lay the doors on a grid whose column count divides the row: `.doors { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; } @media (min-width: 600px) { .doors { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } } @media (min-width: 1200px) { .doors { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } }` (drop the flex basis on .doorItem). Eight doors then fill 1, 2 or 4 columns evenly; a hidden door leaves one hole instead of a stretched door.
prior_overlap: Not reported by AUDIT-1, AUDIT-2 or tasmeem (X4.1 fixed the CTA baseline inside the doors at 1440 only).

title: The rooms grids leave empty cells at common widths: على الرف shows its three doors as 2 + 1 on an iPad, and the edge-to-edge photo mosaics end with a missing photo
evidence: auto-fit grids pick a column count from the width, not from the item count. Width sweep (rows.mjs, 10px steps, holes in the last row): /shelf doors lattice (3 items, --tile 280px) 630-930px; /shelf ذرى mosaic (6 photos, --tile 220px) 880-1310px; /passed products mosaic (8 photos, --tile 340px) 1020-1359px and from 1700px; /passed brand wall (11 + one weave filler) 1120-1299px and from 1700px; /shelf flavours (5 + filler) from 1510px. Screenshots: shots/shelf-doors-768x1024.png (ذرى and the cup on one row, the boutique door alone with a sand hole beside it), shots/passed-products-1280x800.png (3 + 3 + 2 photos, the bottom-left cell empty), shots/passed-brands-1280x800.png (5 + 5 + 2, three empty cells).
impact: On an iPad in portrait (768-834px) the shelf table of contents looks unfinished, and the dessert and ذرى mosaics, which DESIGN.md calls edge-to-edge grids with no gaps, end with a blank tile on most laptops. Cosmetic.
proposed_fix: Give each list a filler that always closes its last row: an aria-hidden weave cell placed with `grid-column-end: -1` (it spans from the next free column to the end) and `min-block-size: var(--edge-weave)` (alone on a new row it is just a 28px weave strip); the brand wall and flavours already have such a cell, so change its rule in passed.module.css/.shelf.module.css and add one to the two mosaics. For the three shelf doors, use 1 column below 900px and `repeat(3, 1fr)` from 900px instead of auto-fit.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 PUBLIC-style-10 fixed the solid line-coloured block in unfilled lattice cells (holes now show the band); the holes themselves remain at these widths.

title: كوب ضوء القمر renders are served from a 720px file while drawn up to 1000px wide: the mug's Arabic name and Anas's signature blur (40 manifest entries lack their source-width derivative)
evidence: prepare-media.mjs ships the source's own width whenever no standard breakpoint reaches it (lines 238-246, `widths.push(sourceWidth)`), but the committed manifest predates that rule for 40 entries: a node check over the manifest lists render-83 1134px -> 360,720; render-84 1134 -> 360,720; factory-mug-inside_original-ONLY 960 -> 360,720; 24-boxed-loaf-cake 1097 -> 360,720 (and the vignettes, logos and product photos). /shelf draws render-83 at `inline-size: min(100%, 1000px)` (shelf.module.css:170): sharp.mjs measures 1000 css px from render-83-720.webp = 1.39x at DPR 1 and 2.78x at DPR 2 (1440, 1920); render-84 1.67-1.83x at DPR 2. shots/moon-render-1440-dpr2-crop.png: «ضوء القمر» on the rim and the signature are soft and stair-stepped.
impact: The opening picture of the cup's article, the product Anas is manufacturing, looks blurry on every retina laptop and phone, exactly on the Arabic lettering of the cup. No upscaled file is needed: the 1134px source exists.
proposed_fix: Run `node scripts/prepare-media.mjs --only=render-83,render-84,factory-mug-inside_original-ONLY,24-boxed-loaf-cake` (or for all 40 stale ids) and commit the new derivatives with the manifest; add a check (unit test or check:export) that every manifest entry's last derivative equals its sourceWidth.
prior_overlap: The rule was a P01 round-3 audit fix applied with --only to a few ids (thura-* show their source width); these entries were never regenerated.

title: /passed dessert mosaic and the ذرى mosaic declare `sizes` smaller than the tiles they fill, so photos are drawn 1.2-1.8x larger than the file chosen
evidence: `sizes="(min-width: 1024px) 25vw, 50vw"`, but the mosaic (--tile 340px, auto-fit) is 3 columns (33vw) from 1020 to 1359px, and every photo is cover-cropped to 1:1, so a landscape photo is drawn at tile height x its aspect. sharp.mjs (drawn device px / file px): 1280 DPR1 23-caramel-popcorn-cheesecake-360 1.45x, 26-murady-cake-and-coffee-360 1.84x, the six others 1.19x; 1280 DPR2 the 720 files 1.19-1.84x; 1440 DPR1 1.22-1.55x; 360 DPR2 1.22-1.55x. Same pattern on /shelf (ShelfRoomView.tsx:138, `(min-width: 1024px) 17vw, 50vw`): at 1024 the tiles are 25vw, thura-*-360 drawn 1.42x at DPR 2.
impact: The product photos, the room's showcase of what Anas made, look soft on most laptops; the scroll zoom (scale up to 1.16) adds to it. The right files exist; the browser is told to pick smaller ones.
proposed_fix: State the real slot: passed `sizes="(min-width: 1360px) 25vw, (min-width: 1020px) 34vw, 50vw"` and shelf `sizes="(min-width: 1320px) 17vw, (min-width: 880px) 25vw, 50vw"`, and allow for the 1:1 cover crop of landscape photos (declare about 1.25x the slot, e.g. `42vw` at three columns).
prior_overlap: AUDIT-1 X7.1 fixed `sizes` on the /book hero only.

title: بنيتُ هنا: on a laptop-height window the opening drone film shrinks to fit 94vh and sticks to the right, leaving a dark slab only on the left
evidence: `.openingFilm > div > div { max-block-size: 94vh; }` caps the 16:9 VideoTile's height; Chrome carries the cap through the aspect ratio into the width, and the narrower block sits at the inline start (right in RTL). misc1.mjs at 1440x789 (a 1440x900 laptop minus browser chrome): figure [0, 60, 1440, 790], tile [122, 60, 1319, 742], so a 122px aub-900 slab on the left and none on the right (shots/built-opening-1440x789.png); films.mjs at 740x360: tile [138, 1650, 602, 338] inside a 740px figure. At 1440x900 the tile is full width, which is why the 1440 screenshots never showed it.
impact: On most laptops the room's centre-piece film looks off-centre, as if the frame were broken. Cosmetic.
proposed_fix: Centre the capped tile: add `margin-inline: auto;` to `.openingFilm > div > div` (built.module.css:64-66).
prior_overlap: tasmeem LA-13 covered the upright pair at the top of /built (now centred), not this film.

title: Font swap shifts the first screen of the rooms: the hero tagline face (Serif Display 400) is not preloaded and no fallback is metric-matched; /passed on a slow phone scores CLS 0.127
evidence: Every @font-face is `font-display: swap` with the generic `serif` / `system-ui` fallback (globals.css:5-34, tokens.css:38-39) and no size-adjust/ascent-override; the layout preloads only Serif Display Medium and Sans Bold (layout.tsx:72-79), while every room's first screen also uses Serif Display Regular (`.t-lead`, RoomHero tagline, weight 400). cls.mjs on the export with 150 ms / 1.6 Mbps throttling, no scrolling: /passed 360x640 CLS 0.1272 (0.1019 at 2.47 s from the title and t-lead reflowing as the faces swap, then 0.0253 at 4.77 s when the unpreloaded Regular arrives and the brand wall moves); /started 360x640 0.0323 with its late shift at 4.67 s on the article; the other pages 0.001-0.005.
impact: On a slow mobile connection the poster-size room titles and the tagline jump once the Thmanyah faces arrive, and on /passed the whole first screen moves twice (above the 0.1 'good' line of Core Web Vitals). Field values depend on the platform's Arabic fallback (Noto Naskh on Android, Geeza/Times on iOS).
proposed_fix: Preload `thmanyahserifdisplay-Regular.woff2` with the other two (it is on every room's first screen), and give each family a metric-matched local fallback (`@font-face { font-family: 'Thmanyah Serif Display Fallback'; src: local('Times New Roman'), local('Noto Naskh Arabic'); size-adjust/ascent-override/descent-override tuned to Thmanyah }`) placed before `serif` in `--font-display` and `--font-body`.
prior_overlap: DESIGN.md records the two preloads as a choice; no earlier audit measured layout shift under throttling.

title: A room renamed in the admin keeps its old name in the browser tab and on the neighbouring rooms' doors: the four page titles and every RoomNav label are literals
evidence: Each room's «العنوان» is an editable, non-blank admin field (src/admin/collections/rooms.ts:58, 85, 142, 209) and RoomHero prints it as the <h1> (`title={room.title}`), but `export const metadata: Metadata = { title: 'بدأتُ من هنا' }` (and 'بنيتُ هنا', 'مررتُ من هنا', 'على الرف' in built/passed/shelf page.tsx:6) and the doors at the end of each room are literals: StartedRoomView.tsx:176 `next={{ href: '/built', label: 'بنيتُ هنا' }}`, BuiltRoomView.tsx:200, PassedRoomView.tsx:130, ShelfRoomView.tsx:298. The home doors and the header labels are CMS fields (FOUNDATION-1, D44), so after a rename the same room carries up to three names.
impact: If Anas edits a room title (the admin invites it and requires it non-blank), the tab, the history entry, screen-reader page announcements and the previous/next doors on the other rooms keep the old title; nothing tells him those places exist.
proposed_fix: Read the names from the published documents: `generateMetadata` in the four page.tsx returning `{ title: room.title }`, and pass the neighbours' titles into the views (the home page already loads all four rooms) instead of literals; or, if the titles are meant to be fixed, make the admin field read-only.
prior_overlap: tasmeem QA (WCAG 2.4.2) added the literal titles; AUDIT-1 X5.7/I45 moved the home doors to the CMS but not these.

title: Once a film plays, its keyboard focus ring is one colour drawn over the moving picture and nearly vanishes (1.0-2.2:1 against the frame)
evidence: VideoTile moves focus to the <video> after «تشغيل» (VideoTile.tsx:73-75), and `.video:focus-visible { outline-offset: -6px; }` draws the band's single `--focus` colour inside the frame: aub on /built (the pair sits on the sand body tone), saffron on /started. The poster button got a two-tone ring (`.play:focus-visible` with an aub-900 inset), the playing film did not. behav2.mjs + pix.mjs on the export, ring pixels (4px inside the edge) against the frame 6px further in: /built first film median 1.41:1, max 2.18, 49 of 49 samples under 3:1 (shots/film-focus-built.png: an aubergine line on a dark roasting frame); /started first film median 1.98:1, 28 of 31 under 3:1 (shots/film-focus-started.png).
impact: A keyboard user who starts a film cannot see where focus is (WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1 for the focus indicator); the next Tab goes into the hidden native controls. Affects every film on /started, /built and /passed.
proposed_fix: Give the playing film the same two-tone ring as the poster button, drawn with outlines (an inset box-shadow paints under a video's frame): `.video:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--aub-900); outline-offset: -6px; }` and `.tile:has(> .video:focus-visible) { outline: 3px solid var(--sand-50); outline-offset: -9px; }`.
prior_overlap: AUDIT-2 PUBLIC-style-8 (the ring was fully clipped) is fixed only partly: the ring is now inside the frame but single-colour over video, the case tasmeem QA-01 row 13 flagged for posters.
